notes.note: Reviewed the combined Device and People route. A current Device remains connected after an operator refusal. An unreadable review asks the operator to sign in before checking its outcome. The group warning names Devices that gain effective full access; a changed set invalidates the reviewed target.

Reviewed the combined refusal contracts against the mounted routes. Directory outages use 503 with a stable code. The legacy Project read refuses unbound records. People writes without operator authority on a current Device use 403 and revoked credentials retain 401. Existing step-up and Station Control admission remain authoritative.

Reviewed the combined SDK delta. Typed People 403 refusals preserve current Device credentials. Valid Project-conversation arrays are preserved on compatible hosts and typed error metadata survives refusals. The full SDK error migration remains open.
